content: The execution successfully fulfilled the HWPX template requirements. The key to success was the identification and removal of `<hp:lineSegArray>` elements within the HWPX XML structure. In HWPX (a ZIP-based XML format), these elements cache layout positions; failing to remove them after text replacement causes character overlapping in viewers. The solution also correctly handled potential XML fragmentation where placeholders (e.g., `{{key}}`) might be split across multiple `<hp:t>` (text) nodes by processing the paragraph's full text and clearing the cache.
